name: Docker Hub
label: Docker Hub HTTP API
description: Docker Hub API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/hub/latest/. Operations: repo_get, repo_list, tag_list, tag_delete, webhook_set, listen. Auth: exchange username+PAT at POST /v2/auth/token and send the JWT as Authorization: Bearer (PAT is not a bearer; /v2/users/login is deprecated). Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). JDK HTTP, official API only. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: repo_get | repo_list | tag_list | tag_delete | webhook_set | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'repo_get'.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operations: repo_list, tag_list.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page_size` for operations: repo_list, tag_list.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: repo_get, repo_list, tag_list, tag_delete, webhook_set, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Docker Hub JWT from POST https://hub.docker.com/v2/auth/token (identifier + PAT/OAT secret). Do not send a PAT as Bearer. /v2/users/login is deprecated. Never logged. Not an Engine socket token.

configurationParameters.label: namespace
configurationParameters.description: Default Docker Hub namespace / org when INPUT namespace is empty.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
